ui.walking: Pim is going somewhere. Catch up when they stop.

nodes.text: Oh! A person. Mind the wet paint. No. Wait. There isn't any. Sorry. I keep thinking they've started.
...Started what?
I'm Pim. I'm waiting for the painters. They said Tuesday. Is it Tuesday?

choices.text: It's whatever day you need it to be.

nodes.text: Definitely. Good. I like definitely. Then they're late, which is better than wrong.
It matters to me. Tuesday is the day the grey ends. Allegedly.
That's either very kind or very slippery. I'll take it as kind. It's Tuesday, then.
Can I ask a favour? If you see a van. Or a ladder. Or anyone holding a tin. Tell them Pim is here, by the... by the nothing. Will you?
You promise. Nobody promises anymore, they say 'we'll see' and then they don't. I'm going to hold you to that, you know. Both hands.
Try. Fine. Trying is a kind of promise with the door left open.
In it for you! Ha. Nothing, probably. But I'll think of something. I'm good at thinking. I've had the time.
One more thing. Your name. I'd like to know who I'm waiting with.
Walker. Suits you. You've got the legs for it.
Passer-by. Hm. Nobody passes by here, though. You're the first. So you're something else, really.
Fair. A mystery. I'll call you the Mystery, in my head. Out loud I'll just say 'you'.
Right. I'm going to check the other side, in case they came round the back. Don't go far. It's nicer with two.
Walker! You're still here. Good. Good good good.
The passer-by! Who didn't pass. Who stayed. I noticed that.
It's you. The Mystery. I waved, earlier. You didn't see. That's fine.
You again! Good.
No van. No ladder. Nobody holding a tin. I checked the other side and it's the same side, only further away.
I've been thinking about the colour. I'm allowed one, I decided. One colour, for everything. Guess it.

choices.text: Grey. Keep it as it is.

nodes.text: ...Yes. Yes! How did you... it's yellow. Don't tell anyone. It's the kind of thing people laugh at.
Blue. Blue is sensible. I didn't pick blue. But I can see you're the sort of person who would, and that's not nothing.
That is the worst thing anyone has said to me, and I've been standing here all day. ...I'm going to pretend you said yellow.
Here's the thing. If they don't come, I had a thought. A bad thought. What if I did it myself? Me. With a brush.
Who's stopping me. Nobody. That's the trouble with nobody, there's so much of them.
The professionals. Yes. You're right. They know about edges. I'd make a mess of the edges.
Help? You'd... with your actual hands? Nobody's offered that. I don't know what to do with my face now.
I need to think about this. Properly. Over there, where it's quieter. Come and find me.
Walker. Still got the legs, good. I've done my thinking, over there where it's quieter. Stand still a minute, it comes out in order.
Passer-by. Still not passing. I've done my thinking, over there where it's quieter. Stand still a minute, it comes out in order.
You. ...Mystery. Sorry, that one was supposed to stay in my head. I've done my thinking, over there where it's quieter. Stand still a minute, it comes out in order.
You. Good. I've done my thinking, over there where it's quieter. Stand still a minute, it comes out in order.
First. It's Tuesday. Definitely. Your word, and I've been using it. It has been Tuesday for a very long time now, and nothing has happened in it.
First. Does it matter what day it is. Your question. I took it over there and sat with it, and the answer is no. I've stopped counting. That's your doing.
First. Whatever day I need it to be. So I tried a few. Wednesday. Thursday. A Sunday, for luck. None of them had painters in.
First. The day. Whichever it is, it's been a long one.
Second. The promise. You made one, with a face like a signed form, so I'm holding you to it. Did anyone come? Did you tell them?

choices.text: No one came. I looked, though.
I told the nothing. The nothing's on it.

nodes.text: Second. No promise from you. 'I'll try.' I was cross about that for a while, over there. Then I thought: at least it isn't a lie waiting to happen. So. Did you try?

choices.text: I'm trying right now. This is me trying.

nodes.text: Second. What's in it for you. I've got your answer, and you'll get it in a minute, after you've earned it. Did anyone come? Did you see anyone?

choices.text: Only you, Pim. Over and over.

nodes.text: Second. Did anyone come? Did you see anyone?

choices.text: Only you, Pim. Over and over.

nodes.text: You looked. That's more than the painters did.
You promised and you didn't look. ...No. It's all right. There's a lot of nothing out there. Anyone could lose a promise in it.
No. All right. At least you're honest, and honest is the colour I've got most of.
Ha. You're ridiculous. I spent the whole walk over there deciding whether I liked that about you. I do. Carry on.
Third. Who's stopping me. That was yours. I took it over there and turned it round for a while and there's nothing on the back of it. So I'm doing it. Myself. Today. One wall, then we'll see.
Third. Wait for the professionals, you said. So I waited. I'm good at it, I've had the practice. But I think I've waited enough, and I think you knew that when you said it.
Third. Can I help, you said. Nobody says that. Well: I'm taking you up on it. You're holding the tin. There's no tin yet. Hold it anyway.
Third. I'm doing it. Myself. Today. One wall, then we'll see.
Yellow, obviously. You guessed it first time. I've decided that means it was always going to be yellow.
Not blue. I know you'd have gone blue. I thought about it, for you. Then I thought: it's my wall.
And it will not be grey, whatever certain people standing right there might have said. I've forgiven you for that. Mostly. Stand a bit further off for this part.
In my colour. You never guessed it. It's yellow. There. Now you know.
Will you stand here while I do it? You don't have to do anything. Just be the person who's here.

choices.text: You don't need me for this.
I'll stand here, but I'm not holding anything.

nodes.text: Tell me something to think while I'm doing the edges. One thing. Edges take a long time.
One wall. Small. Yes. One wall is a size I can look at without sitting down.
Loud! All right. Loud. If anyone laughs I'll say you told me to.
Edges last. Of course. That's the kind of thing a professional would say, and you're not one, so it's better.
Then I'll start. Don't look at the edges.
Noted. No holding. You can be in charge of standing.
No. I suppose I don't. ...I'd have liked it, though. Go on. I'll be here. I'm always here, that's rather the point.
Oh, and your answer. What's in it for you. It's this: you get to be the one who was here. That's all I've got. It's quite a lot, I think. Goodbye for now.
Goodbye, then. Come back when it's done. Come back anyway.
Right. Deep breath. Here goes nothing, and I should know, I've been here with it all day. Goodbye for now.
Still here. Still Tuesday. You came back, though. I'm counting that.
Still here. And it's all right, about the not looking. I've stopped minding. Nearly.
Still here. Still ridiculous, you. I can tell from over here. Don't stop.
Still here. Still Tuesday. One wall at a time.
